title: Roblox Q1 2026 shareholder letter
excerpt: Q1 2026 operating cash flow was USD 629 million, free cash flow was USD 596 million, total cash and investments were USD 6.2 billion, and fully diluted shares were 749 million.
summary: The issuer reported strong Q1 engagement, bookings and cash generation, but reduced 2026 bookings and free-cash-flow growth expectations because of safety headwinds while creator, trust, infrastructure and dilution costs remained material.
